implemented.M1: Original uploaded PDF SHA256/file/submission identity, verified page/segment substrings, confirmed task revision and DataPrep input/output row lineage, actual review_limit issue row/value/message/origins.
implemented.M2: Required file rejection leaves collection waiting with no submission/extraction; real conflicting PDF cannot confirm even with acknowledge_unverified, creates no downstream data/review/release; human correction+confirmation resumes same run at revision 3.
implemented.M4: Real message delivery commits before an injected receipt-update exception. Known queued send remains waiting, fresh factory reads actual message and reconciles original receipt without re-dispatch or changed prior step IDs. Active approval wait consumes approved/rejected/approved hints without moving; late rejected hint cannot override real approval.

fault_injection: Only receipt projection update and explicitly labeled event-delivery hints; original business operations, PDF reader, workers and Flows engine execute unchanged.
remaining_scope: M3 actual process restart and B6 UI/output reconciliation remain separate. This proves loss of success receipt projection after an acknowledged send, not a raw transport timeout with genuinely unknown dispatch.
